title: Condign
summary: CONDIGN, adjective [Latin , worthy. See Dignity.] 1. Deserved; merited; suitable; applied usually to punishment; as, the malefactor has suffered condign punishment. 2. Worthy; merited; as condign prai

inlines.v: CONDIGN, adjective [Latin , worthy. See Dignity.] 1. Deserved; merited; suitable; applied usually to punishment; as, the malefactor has suffered condign punishment. 2. Worthy; merited; as condign praise. [In the latter sense, seldom used.]
